messages:
alina (Finance): @tom quick heads-up — AcmeCorp's private deployment invoice INV-2026-0478 has an unexpected 'Migration Platform Fee' plus the usual 'Platform Fee'. Looks like both charged this renewal cycle. Can someone confirm if migration charge should apply?

tom (Account Manager): Hmm, we did a migration in Jan but it was supposed to be a one-time waiver per our settlement. Contract shows migration charge waived. Can you paste the invoice snippet? I'll check the order notes.

alina (Finance): Snippet below:
```
INV-2026-0478
Customer: AcmeCorp (Private)
Period: 2026-04-01 - 2027-03-31
Lines:
 - Migration Platform Fee: $8,000
 - Platform Fee (annual): $12,000
 - Support - Enterprise (annual): $30,000
 - True-up overage: $1,120
Total: $51,120
```

jess (Cloud Ops): We processed support tier change to Standard on 2026-03-20 via ticket SUP-921. The renewal ran after that, but our support-sync job failed for that customer during the window. Looks like Enterprise was billed full.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0478 generated at 2026-04-02T08:11Z by billing-service v3.4.3; applied discounts: none.

marco (RevOps): Two issues: (1) migration fee should have been waived per settlement code SETT-ACME-2026; (2) support proration to Standard needs to be applied pro rata from 2026-03-20 to renewal. Estimate credits: -Migration $8k, -Support prorated ~ $26k (Enterprise -> Standard for ~11 months?) wait math needed.

alina (Finance): I'll run the proration calc. Also confirm GL mapping: migration -> 4010, platform -> 4001, support -> 4002, true-up -> 4020.

tom (Account Manager): I pulled the order notes: waiver approved by Contracts (email chain) and recorded in SETT-ACME-2026. I'll attach to the AR credit request.

nina (Head of Finance): Approve issuing a credit memo for the migration fee and the support proration. Please include a short audit memo referencing SUP-921 and SETT-ACME-2026. Route credit via AR process with reference CM-2026-0499. Also we should inform the customer with a brief transparency note after credit posts.

marco (RevOps): I'll open an internal ticket to change billing logic: when a settlement code exists for a customer, migration/one-time charges must be suppressed at invoice generation. Ticket BILL-459.

jess (Cloud Ops): I'll attach logs for the support-sync failure and add reproduction steps. We should add a monitoring alert so any support-tier mismatch is detected before invoice generation.

alina (Finance): Action items: 1) I'll create the AR credit request with CM-2026-0499 and attach SETT-ACME-2026 + SUP-921. 2) Hold customer notification until credit posts. 3) Marco to file BILL-459.

tom (Account Manager): I'll draft the customer note for post-credit communication. Short, apologetic, and include the credit memo amount and confirmation number.

nina (Head of Finance): Good. Also loop in Legal if the customer requests contract restatement.

alina (Finance): Credit request submitted to AR queue. ETA credit posting: 3 business days. I'll update thread when CM applied.

tom (Account Manager): Thanks, team. I'll wait for the confirmation before messaging Acme. :white_check_mark:
